model_annotation: This combination bar and line chart illustrates the trend of daily new patient numbers and news media report numbers over a two-month period. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing dates arranged chronologically, with slanted labels displayed at weekly intervals including 2022年7月1日, 2022年7月8日, 2022年7月15日, 2022年7月22日, 2022年7月29日, 2022年8月5日, 2022年8月12日, 2022年8月19日, and 2022年8月26日. The chart features dual vertical value axes. The left vertical axis, which corresponds to the bar data, is labeled "每日新增患者人数" (Daily new patient numbers) and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1800000 with tick mark intervals of 200000. The right vertical axis, corresponding to an overlaid line graph, is labeled "新闻媒体每日报道数目" (Daily news media report numbers) and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6000 with tick mark intervals of 1000. According to the legend at the bottom, the solid teal bars represent "该日全球确诊数量" (Global confirmed cases on that day), while the overlaid blue line represents "有关covid-19新闻数量" (Number of covid-19 related news). The bars are sorted chronologically from left to right and exhibit significant daily fluctuations. The tallest bar occurs shortly after the 2022年7月15日 label, reaching a peak value of exactly 1,600,000 on the left axis. The shortest bars appear early in the timeline just after 2022年7月1日 and again in late August, dropping to approximate values between 360,000 and 400,000. Horizontal gridlines extend across the chart area corresponding to the tick marks on the left vertical axis.
